blendGovernance: GREEN = lead/live/positive ONLY. Never decorative. teamAccent uses var(--primary) only when ahead; boundaries (cricket 4/6) use green accent TEXT not a filled box (I-068 KEEP decision).

GOLD = exactly ONE milestone/victory accent per screen (--se-color-gold / --se-color-win-gold), appearing only after a result is decided or a rank/champion is earned. Never competes with green-for-lead.

CAPSULES (999px) and CIRCLES (50%) are for INTERACTIVE elements only (CTAs, chips, avatars, steppers, medallions) — never for containers/cards, which stay boxy 4px with hard 3px 3px 0 0.5px zero-blur offset shadow and 1–1.5px pure-black hairlines.

HARD SHELL / SOFT CONTENT: scoring arenas (.mono-arena-half, clamp() numerals), competition chrome (fixture ribbon, standings) and the record ledger stay brutalist; warmth (plain-language prompts, rounded chips, breathing pulses, gold celebration) wraps AROUND them, never replaces them.

BREATHING PULSE = live-state signal ONLY (LIVE badge/dot), gentle opacity/glow ~1.2–1.8s, ALWAYS gated in the existing @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) blocks (mono.css:862, 1793). Not decoration; cut it before cutting a load-bearing context signal.

Per-screen SOFT-ELEMENT BUDGET: cap the count of rounded/washed/gold/pulse elements per screen (Cricket-toss and My-teams are the closest-to-dilution surfaces — hold to one gold + two greens). When in doubt, brutalize.

ALL new tokens derive from the oklch --primary/action token via color-mix / relative color so they behave in dark + theme modes; ZERO per-screen hardcoded hex (the sole exception: the fixed-size share-card raster subtree, which inlines hex to avoid oklch/color-mix rasterization failures).
This contract ships as comments/docs beside the Foundation tokens; every screen issue references it instead of re-deriving 'constrain gold to one accent'.
backStackRules: Tabs are lateral roots: tab switches are instant (≤100ms opacity, no directional slide); each tab owns its own stack; tapping the active tab scrolls-to-top.
Drill-downs are forward pushes (fast slide-in / shared-element ~200ms); Back always returns to the parent with scroll + filter + query state preserved.
Committing transitions use `replace`: Setup → Live scorer, Create-team → Roster. Back must never re-enter a torn-down setup or re-run creation.
Destructive/exit guards: system-back from a live scorer fires the pause/discard confirm — never a silent pop. Back from Result goes to a safe hub, never into a completed match.
Deep links synthesize parents: cold-start spectator/tournament/roster links get a sane synthesized stack (→ Home or section list) so Back walks up, never exits or 404s.
In-setup steps are internal state synced to history (or back intercepted to decrement the step) so back mid-setup loses nothing.
No back-press may ever land on a broken, empty, or orphan screen. Orphans are deleted (except NewUserFlow — KEEP, it is live at /play), never routed around.

Standing convention: every subsequent screen adopts these rules; a11yContracts.test green + reduced-motion respected is a per-PR acceptance gate; no tab/entry ships pointing at an empty shell and no label promises an absent feature.

crossCutting: Shared token + component + motion layer is the keystone: gold/win-gold, green-wash (#e7f4ee), warm-green-black + green-glow shadows, capsule/circle radii, the breathing-pulse keyframe AND the blend-governance contract must be defined ONCE (derived from oklch via color-mix so they work in dark/theme) plus shared MonoSheet, CaptionChip, SegmentedToggle, AvatarCircle/SportMedallion/LiveDot, EmptyState, and the motion kit. Every screen consumes; nothing forks per-screen hex or keyframes.

Navigation ships in TWO PRs: (1) shared BottomTabNav + Home tab + I-066 label fix on the CURRENT 5-tab IA; (2) the 4-tab restructure (Stats→History, Account→Profile/More, orphan/Guided cleanup) landing BEFORE the social/live/teams epics. The 5th Watch/Friends tab is deferred until those surfaces exist. Screens degrade gracefully; nav is never built inside a per-screen PR.

Real-time/live/spectator infrastructure is missing from production (LiveBroadcastBar, ShareLiveMatch, convex/live.ts, watchUrl exist only in worktrees). NAMED PRE-TASK: diff `.worktrees/live-matches` vs `.claude/worktrees/wf_5fe79697` and pick the canonical worktree before promotion. Then land to src/+convex/, add a public per-match snapshot query + share-token guard (§7.2 minimization + youth name-hiding) BEFORE any spectator/share/live-feed screen. Ship the whole thing as ONE vertical slice (D4) — a spectator screen alone is unreachable.

Shared coaching-status selectors (per-sport) are a single util consumed by every scorer chip, spectator screen and the dashboard band so labels can't drift; presentational chips are FED labels and never embed sport rules. SET/MATCH/BREAK-POINT logic is net-new (grep zero hits today), not free plumbing.

Player-stats + roster-in-scoring model AND a persisted per-point/ball event log are prerequisite backends: attribution sheets, momentum/point-by-point viz, spectator graphs and team-stats depth are hollow until these land (draftState is discarded on completion; scorers track team scores only). AppAttributionSheet must extend useAppScoringPrompt's isInteractionLocked to cover sheet-open state or the auto-finish timer double-counts.

Social layer (friends schema) and Teams membership model + convex/teams functions are prerequisite backends; every add-friend/team CTA is a dead button until they exist and must be feature-flagged/cloud-auth-gated with anon sign-in-to-sync fallbacks. Social is asymmetric-follow only (one graph, no request inbox).

Monolith decomposition first: extract MonoQuickSetup from MonoQuickMatch (I-085) as a pure lift before restyling Setup/Toss/Customize (Setup/Dispatch/Scorer full break-up is the D5 follow-up); treat Tournament shell extraction + ~113-instance blue→--se-* migration as its own no-visual PR BEFORE the tournament blend AND before the fixture ribbon (prOrder violation fixed).

Match-end flow (Result → Scorecard → Share) is entirely missing and is flow/IA's Critical #1 — it lands in M1: sport-agnostic MonoMatchResult with a lineScores[] contract + the FULL-TIME overlay, wire Sets as reference, then roll out Goals/Tennis/Cricket, with MonoLiveGame as a separate follow-up. Every retention/virality hook lives here.

In-match safety is Critical #2: confirm-ON-Discard (demoted into the ⋯ menu), ONE unified End control, differentiated Undo, a back-press pause-guard, a 'Saved to history' ack, and a between-sets interstitial for sets sports. The ⋯ menu must exist BEFORE the Share-live QR sheet (whose trigger wiring depends on it).

Attribution capture, share-card rasterization, momentum charts, and share/QR sheets are shared primitives requested across scorers/spectator/history — build each ONCE (AppAttributionSheet, shareCardImage/canvas, MomentumChart, MonoShareLiveSheet, spectator primitives) and consume, never fork per screen.

Empty/first-run states and team-only (anonymous, no-roster) casual mode are cross-cutting UX gaps: reuse the shared EmptyState everywhere and make team-only the single OFF gate (useTeamOnlyMode) that future attribution shares. No screen shows fake data; honest empty states never eject the user into scoring.

Design-debt reconciliation is DONE (see debt-reconciliation.md): I-013/I-044/I-047/I-049/I-051/I-052/I-066/I-068/I-086 are already fixed — do NOT re-file them. Only residuals fold into screen issues: I-053 residual = a visual confirmation screenshot pass folded into the History blend issue (no code); I-068 = KEEP the green 4/6 boundary accent (now documented semantic), decided inside the Cricket LO scorer issue. Do not bulk-file the I-xxx list.

Numerous verified factual slips in the source designs must be honored at build time: many 'keeps brutalist' hard-offset shadows do NOT exist today and are NEW work (Play-hub tiles, Match-detail cards, cricket keypad circles); radius.pill=999px not 99px; --shadow has a 2nd slightly-blurred layer; the .mono-arena-seam is net-new markup (not a repurpose); AppScoringPrompt is a centered modal not a sheet; sportConfig has no `target` field; MonoLiveGame is an orphan reachable by no route; --se-color-win-gold does not exist. A11y is a per-PR acceptance gate, not prose: a11yContracts.test green + reduced-motion respected (all breathing pulses / overlays / side-swaps gated in the existing @media(prefers-reduced-motion) blocks, mono.css:862/1793) + role=img/role=alert/role=alertdialog retention + focus-trap parity on every sheet. Every issue carries an explicit a11y field.

Build execution hygiene: concurrent Opus build agents each work in an ISOLATED worktree (forge worktree create), never the shared main checkout; cap WIP and use a merge-train (update only the next-at-bat PR) with head-SHA review-settle; milestone boundaries (M1→M2→M3) are re-planning checkpoints.
